text_en: Then the high priest asked him, “Are these things so? ”
text_cn: 大司祭遂问说：“真是这样吗？”

text_en: And Stephen replied: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me. The God of glory appeared to our ancestor Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
text_cn: 斯德望答说：“诸位仁人弟兄，诸位父老，请听！ 当我们的祖先亚巴郎还在美索不达米亚，还未住在哈兰以前，荣耀的天主曾显现给他，

text_en: and said to him, ‘Leave your country and your relatives and go to the land that I will show you. ’
text_cn: 向他说：‘你要离开你的故乡和你的家族，往我所指示你的地方去！’

text_en: Then he left the country of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, God had him move from there to this country in which you are now living.
text_cn: 那时，他遂离开了加色丁人的地方，住在哈兰；他父亲死后，天主又叫他从那里迁移，来到你们现今所住的地方。

text_en: He did not give him any of it as a heritage, not even a foot’s length, but promised to give it to him as his possession and to his descendants after him, even though he had no child.
text_cn: 在此地天主并没有赐给他产业，连脚掌那么大的地方也没有给，却应许了把此地赐给他和他以后的子孙做产业，虽然当时他还没有儿子。

text_en: And God spoke in these terms, that his descendants would be resident aliens in a country belonging to others, who would enslave them and mistreat them during four hundred years.
text_cn: 天主还这样说过：‘他的子孙要侨居异地，人要奴役虐待他们，共四百年之久。’

text_en: ‘But I will judge the nation that they serve, ’ said God, ‘and after that they shall come out and worship me in this place. ’
text_cn: 天主还说：‘我要惩治那奴役他们的异民。此后，他们要出来，要在这地方恭敬我。’

text_en: Then he gave him the covenant of circumcision. And so Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day; and Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
text_cn: 天主又赐给了他割损的盟约；这样，他生了依撒格后，第八天，给他行了割损礼。以后，依撒格生了雅各伯，雅各伯生了十二位宗祖。

text_en: “The patriarchs, jealous of Joseph, sold him into Egypt; but God was with him,
text_cn: 宗祖们嫉妒若瑟，把他卖到埃及，天主却同他在一起，

text_en: and rescued him from all his afflictions, and enabled him to win favor and to show wisdom when he stood before Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and over all his household.
text_cn: 救他脱离了一切磨难，并在埃及王法郎面前使他得宠，有智慧，法郎就派他总理埃及和王家事务。

text_en: Now there came a famine throughout Egypt and Canaan, and great suffering, and our ancestors could find no food.
text_cn: 后来在全埃及和客纳罕发生了饥馑和大难，我们的祖先找不到食物。

text_en: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there on their first visit.
text_cn: 雅各伯听说在埃及有粮食，就打发了我们的祖先去，这是第一次。

text_en: On the second visit Joseph made himself known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family became known to Pharaoh.
text_cn: 第二次，若瑟被他的兄弟们认出来了。法郎也明悉了若瑟的亲族。

text_en: Then Joseph sent and invited his father Jacob and all his relatives to come to him, seventy-five in all;
text_cn: 若瑟遂打发人请自己的父亲和所有同族前来，共计七十五人。

text_en: so Jacob went down to Egypt. He himself died there as well as our ancestors,
text_cn: 雅各伯下到了埃及，以后他和我们的祖先都死了；

text_en: and their bodies were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham had bought for a sum of silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
text_cn: 后来他们被运到舍根，埋葬在亚巴郎用银价从哈摩尔的儿子在舍根所买的坟墓中。

text_en: “But as the time drew near for the fulfillment of the promise that God had made to Abraham, our people in Egypt increased and multiplied
text_cn: 天主向亚巴郎所应承的恩许的时期来近了，这民族在埃及就逐渐繁殖增多起来，

text_en: until another king who had not known Joseph ruled over Egypt.
text_cn: 直到另一位不认识若瑟的君王起来统治埃及，

text_en: He dealt craftily with our race and forced our ancestors to abandon their infants so that they would die.
text_cn: 他就用计谋压迫我们的亲族，虐待我们的祖先，叫他们抛弃自己的婴孩，不容生存。

text_en: At this time Moses was born, and he was beautiful before God. For three months he was brought up in his father’s house;
text_cn: 就在那时期梅瑟诞生了，他为天主所喜爱；在父亲家中养育了三个月。

text_en: and when he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter adopted him and brought him up as her own son.
text_cn: 他被抛弃后，法郎的女儿却将他拾去，当自己的儿子养育。

text_en: So Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in his words and deeds.
text_cn: 梅瑟学习了埃及人的各种智慧；他讲话办事，都有才干。

text_en: “When he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his relatives, the Israelites.
text_cn: 当他满了四十岁的时候，他心中起了看望自己的弟兄──以色列子民的愿望。

text_en: When he saw one of them being wronged, he defended the oppressed man and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian.
text_cn: 他看见一个人受欺压，就加以卫护，为受欺负的人报仇，打死了那个埃及人。

text_en: He supposed that his kinsfolk would understand that God through him was rescuing them, but they did not understand.
text_cn: 他以为自己的弟兄明白天主要藉他的手拯救他们，但他们却不明白。

text_en: The next day he came to some of them as they were quarreling and tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you wrong each other? ’
text_cn: 第二天，他看见他们打架，就劝他们和解说：同仁！你们原是弟兄，为什么彼此伤害呢？

text_en: But the man who was wronging his neighbor pushed Moses aside, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
text_cn: 那欺压近人的推开他说：谁立了你做我们的首领和判官？

text_en: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday? ’
text_cn: 难道你愿意杀死我，就像昨天你杀死了那埃及人一样吗？

text_en: When he heard this, Moses fled and became a resident alien in the land of Midian. There he became the father of two sons.
text_cn: 梅瑟因这句话，便逃跑了，在米德杨地方作客，在那里生了两个儿子。

text_en: “Now when forty years had passed, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in the flame of a burning bush.
text_cn: 过了四十年，在西乃山的旷野里，有一位使者在荆棘丛火焰中显现给他。

text_en: When Moses saw it, he was amazed at the sight; and as he approached to look, there came the voice of the Lord:
text_cn: 梅瑟一见，就奇怪这异像；他正要前去观察，有上主的声音说：

text_en: ‘I am the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. ’ Moses began to tremble and did not dare to look.
text_cn: ‘我是你祖先的天主，即亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯的天主。’梅瑟就战栗起来，不敢前去观察。

text_en: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off the sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
text_cn: 上主向他说：‘将你脚上的鞋脱下！因为你站的地方是圣地。

text_en: I have surely seen the mistreatment of my people who are in Egypt and have heard their groaning, and I have come down to rescue them. Come now, I will send you to Egypt. ’
text_cn: 我看见了我百姓在埃及的苦楚，也听见了他们的哀叹，遂下来拯救他们。现在你来，我要打发你到埃及去。’

text_en: “It was this Moses whom they rejected when they said, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge? ’ and whom God now sent as both ruler and liberator through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
text_cn: 这梅瑟就是他们曾否定说：‘谁立了你做我们的首领和判官’的，天主却藉着在荆棘中显现的使者的手，打发他做首领和救赎者。

text_en: He led them out, having performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
text_cn: 就是他领了他们出来，在埃及，在红海，在旷野四十年之久，行了奇迹异事。

text_en: This is the Moses who said to the Israelites, ‘God will raise up a prophet for you from your own people as he raised me up. ’
text_cn: 这人就是那给以色列子民说：‘天主要从你们弟兄们中间，给你们兴起一位像我似的先知’的梅瑟。

text_en: He is the one who was in the congregation in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him at Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors; and he received living oracles to give to us.
text_cn: 就是他在旷野时，在会众中，立在西乃山给他说话的使者和我们的祖先之间，领受生命的话，传授给我们。

text_en: Our ancestors were unwilling to obey him; instead, they pushed him aside, and in their hearts they turned back to Egypt,
text_cn: 我们的祖先却不肯听从他，反而拒绝他；他们的心已转向埃及，

text_en: saying to Aaron, ‘Make gods for us who will lead the way for us; as for this Moses who led us out from the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him. ’
text_cn: 遂向亚郎说：‘请给我们制造神像，在我们面前引路，因为领我们出埃及地的这位梅瑟，我们不知道他遭遇了什么事。’

text_en: At that time they made a calf, offered a sacrifice to the idol, and reveled in the works of their hands.
text_cn: 他们就在那几天制造了一个牛犊，向那偶像奉献祭品，并因他们手中的作品而欢乐。

text_en: But God turned away from them and handed them over to worship the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you offer to me slain victims and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
text_cn: 于是天主转过身去，任凭他们恭敬天上的军旅，就如在《先知书》上所载的：‘以色列家！你们四十年在旷野中，何尝向我奉献过牺牲和祭品？

text_en: No; you took along the tent of Moloch, and the star of your god Rephan, the images that you made to worship; so I will remove you beyond Babylon. ’
text_cn: 你们抬着摩肋客的帐幕和楞番神的星辰，为朝拜你们所制造的偶像。为此，我要把你们迁徙到巴比伦那边去。’

text_en: “Our ancestors had the tent of testimony in the wilderness, as God directed when he spoke to Moses, ordering him to make it according to the pattern he had seen.
text_cn: 我们的祖先在旷野中有一个作证的帐幕，这帐幕就是天主吩咐梅瑟，按他所指示的式样制造的。

text_en: Our ancestors in turn brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations that God drove out before our ancestors. And it was there until the time of David,
text_cn: 我们的祖先相继承受了它；当天主把异民从我们祖先的面前赶走之后，他们便同若苏厄将此帐幕运到继承为业之地，直到达味的时日。

text_en: who found favor with God and asked that he might find a dwelling place for the house of Jacob.
text_cn: 达味在天主面前获得了宠爱，就恳求要为雅各伯的天主寻找一个住所；

text_en: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.
text_cn: 撒罗满便为天主建筑了殿宇。

text_en: Yet the Most High does not dwell in houses made with human hands; as the prophet says,
text_cn: 但至高者本不住在人手所建造的殿宇中：正如先知说：

text_en: ‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me, says the Lord, or what is the place of my rest?
text_cn: ‘天是我的宝座，地是我的脚凳。你们要为我建筑什么样的殿宇？──上主说──或者我安息的地方是怎样的呢？

text_en: Did not my hand make all these things? ’
text_cn: 这一切不是我的手所造的吗？’

text_en: “You stiff-necked people, uncircumcised in heart and ears, you are forever opposing the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors used to do.
text_cn: 执拗和心耳未受割损的人啊！你们时常反抗圣神，你们的祖先怎样，你们也怎样。

text_en: Which of the prophets did your ancestors not persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, and now you have become his betrayers and murderers.
text_cn: 哪一位先知，你们的祖先没有迫害过？他们杀害了那些预言义人来临的人，现在你们都成了那义人的出卖者和凶手。

text_en: You are the ones that received the law as ordained by angels, and yet you have not kept it. ”
text_cn: 你们这些人接受了藉天使所传布的法律，却不遵守。”

text_en: When they heard these things, they became enraged and ground their teeth at Stephen.
text_cn: 他们一听这些话，怒从心起，向他咬牙切齿。

text_en: But filled with the Holy Spirit, he gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
text_cn: 斯德望却充满了圣神，注目向天，看见天主的光荣，并看见耶稣站在天主右边，

text_en: “Look, ” he said, “I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God! ”
text_cn: 遂说道：“看，我见天开了，并见人子站在天主右边。”

text_en: But they covered their ears, and with a loud shout all rushed together against him.
text_cn: 他们都大声乱嚷，掩着自己的耳朵一致向他扑去，

text_en: Then they dragged him out of the city and began to stone him; and the witnesses laid their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
text_cn: 把他拉出城外，用石头砸死了。证人脱下自己的衣服放在名叫扫禄的青年人脚前。

text_en: While they were stoning Stephen, he prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. ”
text_cn: 当他们用石头砸斯德望的时候，他祈求说：“主耶稣！接我的灵魂去罢！”

text_en: Then he knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them. ” When he had said this, he died.
text_cn: 遂屈膝跪下，大声呼喊说：“主，不要向他们算这罪债！”说了这话，就死了。
